I don't really feel deeply sad or depressed, but during the times I'm not high, I just feel completely flat, tired, and empty of any spark to do anything.\n\nDoctor: Can you estimate how many days or weeks you typically spend in these 'high' or 'overcharged' states versus the 'flat' states, and do these episodes follow a pattern or cycle?\n\nPatient: Ever since we moved here, those high, overcharged spells have kept coming back and lasting for weeks at a time, taking up most of this past year. But there were also a couple of times, lasting at least two or three weeks, where I didn't feel high or low, just completely flat and tired. Even during those flat times, I still heard that man's voice calling my name and felt like the neighbors were watching me.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about the voice you mentioned, like what it sounds like and what it says when it calls your name?\n\nPatient: It is a man's voice that I hear clear as day, especially when I'm alone in my room with the radio off. He calls my name and comments on everything I am doing, sometimes telling me that I am failing my mission. Nobody else can hear him, and it doesn't sound like it is coming from outside the room at all.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever believed that the voice you hear is real, or have you always known it was just a voice in your head?\n\nPatient: To be honest, it feels completely real to me when it happens, like a physical person is right there in the room with me. Even though I know nobody else can hear it, it is so clear as day that I can't help but believe it's real. He is constantly commenting on what I'm doing and telling me I'm failing my mission, and it's very hard to ignore.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever experienced any periods where you did not hear the voice or have these beliefs about the neighbors watching you, and if so, did those periods coincide with your 'high' or 'flat' states?\n\nPatient: Actually, I hear that man's voice and feel watched during both my \"high\" energy times and my \"flat,\" quiet times. These experiences don't seem to go away based on how I'm feeling; they have been happening pretty consistently regardless of my mood.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever acted on the instructions or comments made by the voice, or have you felt compelled to respond to it in any way?\n\nPatient: I'm not really sure how to answer that, but I don't think I have ever acted on what he tells me to do. Sometimes I do talk back to him when I hear him, though, and my daughter says she catches me arguing or talking to myself in the hallway.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever had any other experiences where you saw, smelled, tasted, or felt things that weren't there, besides hearing the man's voice?\n\nPatient: No, I haven't seen, smelled, tasted, or felt anything else like that. It is really only that man's voice that I hear when I'm alone in my room with the radio turned off. Nothing else like that happens to me.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever believed that you have special powers, are on a mission, or have a special identity, aside from feeling like you're failing your mission as the voice comments?\n\nPatient: Yes, I do sometimes feel that way. I believe God saved me from my fall because I'm meant to be a special messenger for the neighborhood. I've even felt like I could run the entire church better than the priest if they would just listen to my ideas.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe more about what you mean by being a 'special messenger' and how that relates to the voice you hear and your feelings of being watched?\n\nPatient: I believe God kept me alive after my fall because I have a special mission as a messenger for our neighborhood, and I feel I could run the church better than the priest. But that voice constantly calls my name to tell me I am failing this mission, which makes me feel very pressured. I'm convinced the neighbors and churchgoers are watching my every move, using hidden tests in my daily life to see if I am unfit to live on my own.\n\nDoctor: Can you clarify if the voice you hear and the beliefs about being a special messenger or being watched are present during both your 'high' and 'flat' states, and if they seem to influence your mood or energy levels in any way?\n\nPatient: Yes, I experience them in both states. On my high days when I am buzzing around cleaning, the voice still tells me I'm failing my mission and I feel watched by the neighbors. Even during those flat, quiet weeks when I have no energy at all, I still hear him commenting on me and feel convinced I'm being tested, so it doesn't really change with my mood.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe if there are any distinct boundaries or transitions between your 'high' and 'flat' states, or if they tend to blend together, and how the voice and your beliefs about your mission and being watched relate to these states?\n\nPatient: Sometimes I can flip from being wired to feeling flat very quickly, but the voice and the testing never really stop. On my high days when I'm buzzing around cleaning, I still hear him saying I'm failing my mission and feel the neighbors watching me. Even during those quiet weeks when I'm just flat and tired, that voice and the feeling of being tested stay with me the whole time.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if the voice you hear and your beliefs about being a special messenger or being watched seem to be directly related to your 'high' or 'overcharged' states, or if they are separate experiences that coexist with your mood episodes?\n\nPatient: They seem like separate things that just happen at the same time, because they don't depend on how much energy I have. On my high days when I'm busy cleaning, the voice still tells me I'm failing and I feel watched, but even during those long, flat weeks when I don't feel high or low at all, I still hear him commenting and feel convinced the neighbors are testing me.\n\nDoctor: Do you think the voice you hear and your feelings of being watched are more closely related to your own thoughts and feelings, or do they seem to be coming from outside of yourself, and how do you think they relate to your 'high' and 'flat' states?\n\nPatient: The voice sounds very clear and real, though I know it doesn't actually come from the outside. It happens during both my high days when I'm buzzing around cleaning, and my flat days when I feel tired and down. I also get so restless that I can't sit still, cleaning the apartment or rearranging closets at midnight and starting multiple projects that I never finish.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about how long these 'high' or 'overcharged' periods typically last, and do you experience any periods of feeling extremely low or depressed that last for days or weeks?\n\nPatient: Those overcharged spells have kept coming back and lasting quite a long time over this past year, much longer than the quiet stretches. I don't really feel deeply sad or depressed, but during the times I'm not high, I just feel completely flat, tired, and empty of any spark to do anything.\n\nDoctor: Can you estimate how many days or weeks you typically spend in these 'high' or 'overcharged' states versus the 'flat' states, and do these episodes follow a pattern or cycle?\n\nPatient: Ever since we moved here, those high, overcharged spells have kept coming back and lasting for weeks at a time, taking up most of this past year. But there were also a couple of times, lasting at least two or three weeks, where I didn't feel high or low, just completely flat and tired. Even during those flat times, I still heard that man's voice calling my name and felt like the neighbors were watching me.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about the voice you mentioned, like what it sounds like and what it says when it calls your name?\n\nPatient: It is a man's voice that I hear clear as day, especially when I'm alone in my room with the radio off. He calls my name and comments on everything I am doing, sometimes telling me that I am failing my mission. Nobody else can hear him, and it doesn't sound like it is coming from outside the room at all.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever believed that the voice you hear is real, or have you always known it was just a voice in your head?\n\nPatient: To be honest, it feels completely real to me when it happens, like a physical person is right there in the room with me. Even though I know nobody else can hear it, it is so clear as day that I can't help but believe it's real. He is constantly commenting on what I'm doing and telling me I'm failing my mission, and it's very hard to ignore.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever experienced any periods where you did not hear the voice or have these beliefs about the neighbors watching you, and if so, did those periods coincide with your 'high' or 'flat' states?\n\nPatient: Actually, I hear that man's voice and feel watched during both my \"high\" energy times and my \"flat,\" quiet times. These experiences don't seem to go away based on how I'm feeling; they have been happening pretty consistently regardless of my mood.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever acted on the instructions or comments made by the voice, or have you felt compelled to respond to it in any way?\n\nPatient: I'm not really sure how to answer that, but I don't think I have ever acted on what he tells me to do. Sometimes I do talk back to him when I hear him, though, and my daughter says she catches me arguing or talking to myself in the hallway.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever had any other experiences where you saw, smelled, tasted, or felt things that weren't there, besides hearing the man's voice?\n\nPatient: No, I haven't seen, smelled, tasted, or felt anything else like that. It is really only that man's voice that I hear when I'm alone in my room with the radio turned off. Nothing else like that happens to me.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever believed that you have special powers, are on a mission, or have a special identity, aside from feeling like you're failing your mission as the voice comments?\n\nPatient: Yes, I do sometimes feel that way. I believe God saved me from my fall because I'm meant to be a special messenger for the neighborhood. I've even felt like I could run the entire church better than the priest if they would just listen to my ideas.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe more about what you mean by being a 'special messenger' and how that relates to the voice you hear and your feelings of being watched?\n\nPatient: I believe God kept me alive after my fall because I have a special mission as a messenger for our neighborhood, and I feel I could run the church better than the priest. But that voice constantly calls my name to tell me I am failing this mission, which makes me feel very pressured. I'm convinced the neighbors and churchgoers are watching my every move, using hidden tests in my daily life to see if I am unfit to live on my own.\n\nDoctor: Can you clarify if the voice you hear and the beliefs about being a special messenger or being watched are present during both your 'high' and 'flat' states, and if they seem to influence your mood or energy levels in any way?\n\nPatient: Yes, I experience them in both states. On my high days when I am buzzing around cleaning, the voice still tells me I'm failing my mission and I feel watched by the neighbors. Even during those flat, quiet weeks when I have no energy at all, I still hear him commenting on me and feel convinced I'm being tested, so it doesn't really change with my mood.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe if there are any distinct boundaries or transitions between your 'high' and 'flat' states, or if they tend to blend together, and how the voice and your beliefs about your mission and being watched relate to these states?\n\nPatient: Sometimes I can flip from being wired to feeling flat very quickly, but the voice and the testing never really stop. On my high days when I'm buzzing around cleaning, I still hear him saying I'm failing my mission and feel the neighbors watching me. Even during those quiet weeks when I'm just flat and tired, that voice and the feeling of being tested stay with me the whole time.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if the voice you hear and your beliefs about being a special messenger or being watched seem to be directly related to your 'high' or 'overcharged' states, or if they are separate experiences that coexist with your mood episodes?\n\nPatient: They seem like separate things that just happen at the same time, because they don't depend on how much energy I have. On my high days when I'm busy cleaning, the voice still tells me I'm failing and I feel watched, but even during those long, flat weeks when I don't feel high or low at all, I still hear him commenting and feel convinced the neighbors are testing me.\n\nDoctor: Do you think the voice you hear and your feelings of being watched are more closely related to your own thoughts and feelings, or do they seem to be coming from outside of yourself, and how do you think they relate to your 'high' and 'flat' states?\n\nPatient: The voice sounds very clear and real, though I know it doesn't actually come from the outside. It happens during both my high days when I'm buzzing around cleaning, and my flat days when I feel tired and down. It just stays with me regardless of how my mood is.\n\nDoctor: Can you help me understand if the voice you hear and your beliefs about being watched or having a special mission are more prominent or influential during your 'high' or 'overcharged' states, or if they remain constant regardless of your mood?\n\nPatient: On my \"high\" days when I'm buzzing around and overcharged, that voice is still right there calling my name and telling me I'm failing my mission, and I feel watched by the neighbors. But even during those quieter, flatter stretches this past year when I didn't feel high or low at all, I still heard that man's voice and stayed convinced people were secretly testing me.\n\nDoctor: Do you think the voice and your beliefs about being watched or having a special mission are directly connected to your mood, or do they seem like separate issues that you're dealing with at the same time?\n\nPatient: It feels like both, because they happen during my high-energy times but also completely on their own. When I am buzzing around, I still hear the voice and feel like I am on a mission while being watched. It persists across both my \"high\" days when I am full of energy and buzzing around, and those \"flat\" stretches when I feel down and tired with no mood extremes. It has just stayed pretty constant this whole past year.\n\nDoctor: Can you clarify if the voice you hear ever tells you to do things that might harm yourself or others, or if it's primarily focused on commenting on your actions and telling you you're failing your mission?\n\nPatient: No, the voice has never told me to hurt myself or anyone else. Ever since we moved into this apartment, the voice and the feeling of being watched have been pretty constant. As for my appetite, I haven't noticed a big change in how much I eat, though I've completely lost the drive to cook.\n\nDoctor: You mentioned feeling 'overcharged' at times, can you describe more about what happens during those periods, such as feeling extremely happy, irritable, or restless?\n\nPatient: Yes, during those times I feel like a motor that won't turn off, talking nonstop and joking, but then I can suddenly flip and snap at my family over little things like how they fold the towels. I also get so restless that I can't sit still, cleaning the apartment or rearranging closets at midnight and starting multiple projects that I never finish.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about how long these 'high' or 'overcharged' periods typically last, and do you experience any periods of feeling extremely low or depressed that last for days or weeks?\n\nPatient: Those overcharged spells have kept coming back and lasting quite a long time over this past year, much longer than the quiet stretches. I also get so restless that I can't sit still, cleaning the apartment or rearranging closets at midnight and starting multiple projects that I never finish.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about how long these 'high' or 'overcharged' periods typically last, and do you experience any periods of feeling extremely low or depressed that last for days or weeks?\n\nPatient: Those overcharged spells have kept coming back and lasting quite a long time over this past year, much longer than the quiet stretches. I don't really feel deeply sad or depressed, but during the times I'm not high, I just feel completely flat, tired, and empty of any spark to do anything.\n\nDoctor: Can you estimate how many days or weeks you typically spend in these 'high' or 'overcharged' states versus the 'flat' states, and do these episodes follow a pattern or cycle?\n\nPatient: Ever since we moved here, those high, overcharged spells have kept coming back and lasting for weeks at a time, taking up most of this past year. But there were also a couple of times, lasting at least two or three weeks, where I didn't feel high or low, just completely flat and tired. Even during those flat times, I still heard that man's voice calling my name and felt like the neighbors were watching me.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me more about the voice you mentioned, like what it sounds like and what it says when it calls your name?\n\nPatient: It is a man's voice that I hear clear as day, especially when I'm alone in my room with the radio off. He calls my name and comments on everything I am doing, sometimes telling me that I am failing my mission. Nobody else can hear him, and it doesn't sound like it is coming from outside the room at all.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever believed that the voice you hear is real, or have you always known it was just a voice in your head?\n\nPatient: To be honest, it feels completely real to me when it happens, like a physical person is right there in the room with me. Even though I know nobody else can hear it, it is so clear as day that I can't help but believe it's real. He is constantly commenting on what I'm doing and telling me I'm failing my mission, and it's very hard to ignore.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever experienced any periods where you did not hear the voice or have these beliefs about the neighbors watching you, and if so, did those periods coincide with your 'high' or 'flat' states?\n\nPatient: Actually, I hear that man's voice and feel watched during both my \"high\" energy times and my \"flat,\" quiet times. These experiences don't seem to go away based on how I'm feeling; they have been happening pretty consistently regardless of my mood.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever acted on the instructions or comments made by the voice, or have you felt compelled to respond to it in any way?\n\nPatient: I'm not really sure how to answer that, but I don't think I have ever acted on what he tells me to do. Sometimes I do talk back to him when I hear him, though, and my daughter says she catches me arguing or talking to myself in the hallway.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever had any other experiences where you saw, smelled, tasted, or felt things that weren't there, besides hearing the man's voice?\n\nPatient: No, I haven't seen, smelled, tasted, or felt anything else like that. It is really only that man's voice that I hear when I'm alone in my room with the radio turned off. Nothing else like that happens to me.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever believed that you have special powers, are on a mission, or have a special identity, aside from feeling like you're failing your mission as the voice comments?\n\nPatient: Yes, I do sometimes feel that way. I believe God saved me from my fall because I'm meant to be a special messenger for the neighborhood. I've even felt like I could run the entire church better than the priest if they would just listen to my ideas.\n\nDoctor: Can you describe more about what you mean by being a 'special messenger' and how that relates to the voice you hear and your feelings of being watched?\n\nPatient: I believe God kept me alive after my fall because I have a special mission as a messenger for our neighborhood, and I feel I could run the church better than the priest. I'm convinced the neighbors and churchgoers are watching my every move, using hidden tests in my daily life to see if I am unfit to live on my own.\n\nDoctor: Can you clarify if the voice you hear and the beliefs about being a special messenger or being watched are present during both your 'high' and 'flat' states, and if they seem to influence your mood or energy levels in any way?\n\nPatient: Yes, I experience them in both states. On my high days when I am buzzing around cleaning, the voice still tells me I'm failing my mission and I feel watched by the neighbors. Even during those quiet weeks when I'm just flat and tired, that voice and the feeling of being tested stay with me the whole time.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if the voice you hear and your beliefs about being a special messenger or being watched seem to be directly related to your 'high' or 'overcharged' states, or if they are separate experiences that coexist with your mood episodes?\n\nPatient: They seem like separate things that just happen at the same time, because they don't depend on how much energy I have. On my high days when I'm busy cleaning, the voice still tells me I'm failing and I feel watched, but even during those long, flat weeks when I don't feel high or low at all, I still hear him commenting and feel convinced the neighbors are testing me.\n\nDoctor: Do you think the voice you hear and your feelings of being watched are more closely related to your own thoughts and feelings, or do they seem to be coming from outside of yourself, and how do you think they relate to your 'high' and 'flat' states?\n\nPatient: The voice sounds very clear and real, though I know it doesn't actually come from the outside. It happens during both my high days when I'm buzzing around cleaning, and my flat days when I feel tired and down. It just stays with me regardless of how my mood is.\n\nDoctor: Can you help me understand if the voice you hear and your beliefs about being watched or having a special mission are more prominent or influential during your 'high' or 'overcharged' states, or if they remain constant regardless of your mood?\n\nPatient: On my \"high\" days when I'm buzzing around and overcharged, that voice is still right there calling my name and telling me I'm failing my mission, and I feel watched by the neighbors. But even during those quieter, flatter stretches this past year when I didn't feel high or low at all, I still heard that man's voice and stayed convinced people were secretly testing me.\n\nDoctor: Do you think the voice and your beliefs about being watched or having a special mission are directly connected to your mood, or do they seem like separate issues that you're dealing with at the same time?\n\nPatient: It feels like both, because they happen during my high-energy times but also completely on their own. Yet, during those long, flat periods where my mood isn't high or low at all, I still hear that man's voice and feel convinced people are testing me.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever had a period where the voice stopped or significantly decreased for a while, and if so, did that coincide with any changes in your 'high' or 'flat' states?\n\nPatient: No, the voice hasn't really stopped or gone away. It persists across both my \"high\" days when I am full of energy and buzzing around, and those \"flat\" stretches when I feel down and tired with no mood extremes. It has just stayed pretty constant this whole past year.\n\nDoctor: Can you clarify if the voice you hear ever tells you to do things that might harm yourself or others, or if it's primarily focused on commenting on your actions and telling you you're failing your mission?\n\nPatient: No, the voice has never told me to hurt myself or anyone else. It is just like I described—it calls my name, comments on what I am doing, and tells me that I am failing my mission. It is very tiring to listen to, but it has never told me to do anything harmful.\n\nDoctor: Can you tell me if you have ever had a period where you did not experience any psychotic symptoms, such as hearing the voice or feeling watched, for at least two weeks, and if so, did that coincide with any changes in your treatment or circumstances?\n\nPatient: No, I haven't really had a period where those things went away. I haven't had any period where both the mood swings and the voices or feelings of being watched completely went away at the same time.\n\nDoctor: Have you ever felt like the voice you hear is controlling your actions or thoughts, or is it more of a commentary on what you're doing?\n\nPatient: No, it doesn't feel like it is taking control of my body or forcing my thoughts, but it acts as a very clear commentary.
